svg.text: SCREENS AND PROGRAM START (GUI, JAVA SWING)
The main Swing screens extend VaksJFrame.
ReceiptDialog extends JDialog and implements Printable.
Main is the program entry point and launches MainExtended.
UserData stores a collection of UserDataBP accounts.
MainExtended holds UserData and UserDataBP references.
Account and ChangePassUI work with account information.
Screens use DataStore for shared table/payment data.
